messages:
sophia: Heads-up — CloudMart marketplace announcement goes live tomorrow 09:00 PT. We should lock down the partner-SEV routing so everyone knows who gets paged and when. Proposing a lightweight path: 1) SI triage in shared channel, 2) Redwood oncall (pager), 3) Partner Eng leads + PM. Thoughts?

mike: +1. Can we make that explicit in a tiny runbook and wire alerts to the shared channel? also: what about a fallback region routing if eu region spikes? :rotating_light:

Anjali: Agree on the runbook. Suggest naming convention for the shared channel: #cm-launch-<partner>-ops and pin a 1-pager. Also add a 1hr warm-standby rotation for the first 24h (signalboarding) so someone is actively monitoring.

David: Signalboarding sounds good — basically pre-assign shifts for first 24h and add an escalation matrix. Quick templates:
```
Alert route: cloudmart.marketplace.* -> #cm-launch-cloudmart-ops (notify first) -> webhook -> partner-pager -> redwood-oncall
Escalation: 0-15m SI -> 15-45m Redwood oncall -> 45m+ Partner Eng
```

sophia: Nice. Can ops-bot auto-create the channel & bridge when an alert threshold is hit? would reduce friction.

ops-bot: action: /autocreate channel #cm-launch-cloudmart-ops when alert.group == "cloudmart.launch"; also expose /bridge create cm-launch --participants @sophia,@mike,@Anjali,@David

mike: One more ask — include a simple checklist pinned in the channel: incident owner, region impacted, customer-impacting? Y/N, rollback steps, communication template for the partner's CSMs.

Anjali: I'll draft the pinned checklist and a 1-page escalation flow this afternoon and drop it into the channel. Also adding a webhook to send high-severity alerts to PagerDuty with a dedicated escalation policy.

sophia: Perfect. For the announcement comms — we'll include a short note explaining the ops pathway and link to the pinned checklist. I'll call out the warm-standby rotation in the partner runbook. :thumbsup:

David: If anything slips through, fallback plan is to open shared-warroom + call with partner leads. Keep bridge template ready:
```
/bridge create cm-launch 
--title "CloudMart Marketplace Launch — War Room" 
--ops @sophia,@mike,@Anjali,@David 
--duration 2h
```

mike: LGTM. Can we also add a postmortem owner assignment rule if we hit Sev2+ within 72h? prevents handoff loops.

Anjali: Good call — will add postmortem owner = partner_eng_lead + redwood_oncall to the runbook.

sophia: Thanks all. I'll create the channel now and invite you. Dropping final runbook link here when ready. :party_parrot:
